text: さびしいとき　おおごえで　なくという。

structure.jp: おおごえで　なくという。
structure.en: it is said to cry loudly.

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.explanation: という at the end of a sentence means 'people say that', for things you only know from others. なくという = 'it is said to cry'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a describing word or verb means 'when'. さびしいとき = 'when it is lonely'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells you the way something is done. おおごえで = 'in a loud voice'.
